title: Thermostat Runtime and Efficiency
dataSources: Zigbee2MQTT device reports (`zigbee2mqtt:device`), Shelly/Tasmota telemetry (`shelly:status`, `tasmota:sensor`), Hue events (`hue:event`), thermostats (`ecobee:thermostat`).
app: Philips Hue, smart plugs (Tasmota/Shelly/TP-Link Kasa), thermostats (Nest/Ecobee), locks, and Zigbee/Z-Wave sensors via MQTT / Zigbee2MQTT bridged to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ecobee:thermostat
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(heat_runtime_s) as heat_s, sum(cool_runtime_s) as cool_s, avg(outdoor_temp_c) as outdoor by _time
| eval heat_hours=round(heat_s/3600,1), cool_hours=round(cool_s/3600,1)
| sort - _time
description: Trends how many hours your heating and cooling actually ran each day alongside the outdoor temperature so you can judge efficiency.
value: Runtime versus outdoor temperature is the honest measure of your home's efficiency; a rising trend at the same weather hints at a failing system or lost insulation.
implementation: Ingest Ecobee/Nest runtime and weather fields; schedule daily and watch runtime against outdoor temperature.
visualization: Chart of daily heating/cooling hours overlaid with outdoor temperature.
grandmaExplanation: It shows how long your heating and cooling ran each day versus the weather, so you can tell if your home is getting less efficient.
